name_en: Biwamasu sashimi — raw slices of Lake Biwa's endemic trout
summary_ja: 琵琶湖にのみ生息するサケ科の固有種ビワマスを三枚におろした刺身。初夏から夏にかけて脂がのり、地元では「琵琶湖の宝石」と呼ばれるほど貴重で、あまり流通しない魚と伝わる。
summary_en: Biwamasu, a trout found only in Lake Biwa, is filleted and served raw as sashimi. The fish grows richest from early to midsummer and is prized locally as "the jewel of Lake Biwa" — a fish so scarce that it rarely reaches markets beyond the lakeshore.
source_title: ビワマス刺身 滋賀県
